hypothesis_title: Salem Tilt-Depth, Swarm-Triggered Seismicity & Hydrothermal Self-Sealing Fault Detector with Within-Fold Counterfactual Exposure Debiasing (H87B-STFD)

empirical_band_discoveries_preregistered.finding: Band 6 correlates at r = +0.9957 with USGS GeoDAWN Airborne Radiometric Total Count (TC) and is strictly positive [3.37, 62.18]; it is total gamma-ray counts, NOT magnetic tilt angle.
empirical_band_discoveries_preregistered.resolution: Compute true Miller-Singh (1994) analytic magnetic tilt angle atan2(100 * B09_tmi_vg, B03_tmi_hg) and Salem et al. (2007) tilt-depth inverse |grad(tilt)| directly from unit-consistent B09 and B03, while treating B06 properly as total radiometric counts.

empirical_band_discoveries_preregistered.finding: Per primary DOE GDR #1391 metadata and Kreemer & Young (2022, DOI 10.1785/0220220153), B10 and B16 are Nevada Geodetic Laboratory dependent (aftershock/swarm) and independent (declustered background) earthquake density models (n=100, a=1.5), NOT distance to earthquake.
empirical_band_discoveries_preregistered.resolution: Form log-swarm excess log10(B10 + 1) - log10(B16) and seismic-to-geodetic coupling log10(B16) / (B04 + eps) to isolate pore-fluid-driven hydrothermal fault swarms beneath zero-scarp basin fill.

ranked_hypotheses.signature: Unit-consistent Salem tilt-depth magnetic contact + upward-continuation demagnetization + opposite-flank gravity/basement flexure + fluid-driven swarm excess + 2m probe F2mDAB / quartz enthalpy excess + 1m/10m scarp-chi bridge, coupled with within-fold counterfactual whole-component exposure debiasing, 4-family heterogeneous learning (Deep-HGB + Regularized-HGB + Smooth Neural MLP + Spline-Logistic), cover-regime propensity normalization, and 300m expected-credit priority disc thinning.
ranked_hypotheses.why_uncatalogued: Over 39% of Great Basin geothermal systems lack surface scarps or springs (Faulds et al., 2011, 2021), and standard catalogue-trained models collapse when d_cat > 0. Counterfactual masking + blind subsurface/hydrothermal signatures directly target buried intrabasin, piedmont, and relay faults.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan/Bonneville pluvial shoreline benches, lateral thermal outflow plumes in permeable fanglomerates, pre-Tertiary pluton intrusive contacts, and primary high-K ash-flow tuffs.
